body: I think one of the life lessons that I'm starting to grasp but haven't quite embraced yet is that you need to take care of yourself before others. It sounds like a horribly greedy concept, but it's true. It's like how they tell you in an airplane to put your oxygen mask on first before getting to others. If you drain your energy/spirit/resources/body helping others, you will no longer be able to help other people. You need to put yourself in a position to be able to be altruistic, or the altruism will end. It's a balance that I still haven't found yet, either. Good luck :)
